issues.description: Examples reference crate-level API functions (compress, decompress, compress_bound, get_frame_content_size, CONTENTSIZE_ERROR, CONTENTSIZE_UNKNOWN) that are not yet migrated. Examples will not compile until the core compression/decompression API is available in src/lib.rs.

notes: Faithfully ported both example programs. Uses #[path = "common.rs"] mod to share common helpers. Parity is partial because the core zstd API functions are not yet available in the Rust crate; once migrated, these examples should be fully functional. String allocation in create_out_filename simplified from manual malloc+strcat to Rust String::format.
